questions.q: Select the grammatically correct option:
o: They can play as well as we can.
They can play as well as us can.
They can play as well as them can.
They can play as well as me can.
questions.s:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e., They can play as well as we can.

  •  Explanation:
  •  Rule: Whenever there is more than one subject in the sentence; the correct pronouns to be used are subjective pronouns. For example: He can run fast; but so can I.

  •  This means both subjects are the doers of the action shown by the verb. So, we must use a subjective pronoun such as 'I', 'We', 'He' etc.
  •  Out of the options, only option 1 shows a subjective pronoun, viz, 'We'. So, it must be the correct answer.

She itself are responsible for this situation of hers.
questions.s:
The correct answer is- herself is​.

Key Points

  • Reflexive pronouns are words ending in -self or -selves that are used when the subject and the object of a sentence are the same.

    • myself, yourself, himself, herself, oneself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, and themselves.
  • Example: 
    • Jack decided to reward himself with a dinner out.

Correct sentence- She herself is responsible for this situation of hers.

 ​​​​Additional Information  

  • Reflexive pronouns do not work as the main subject but the subject pronoun does.
  • Example:
    • Myself will conduct today’s meeting. (incorrect)
    • I will conduct today’s meeting. (correct)

questions_hin.s_hi: Explanation:- Yahan 'but' ka matlab 'ke sivay ya ke alawa' hai. Yaani but yahan par preposition ki tarah work kar rha hai. Isliye uske baad Objective case ka use hoga. 'she' nahi 'her' ka use kiya jayega.
